FN-VFQWLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 197
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 197 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama State Board of
Occupational Therapy until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will
not otherwise affect state or local funding.
